photo_workspace_checks.scope: Isolated Chromium profile; synthetic PNG fixtures only. Multi-batch imports, durable browser storage, SHA-256 deduplication, paging, metadata, same-plane estimates, export, deletion, invalid files, quota failure, and responsive layout.
